issues.description: The restored executable address conversions use duplicate local spec models while the specification module aliases a second model under the exec names.
issues.rationale: At this revision, the exec functions in `mm` are attached to `frame_to_meta_local_spec` and `meta_to_frame_local_spec`, while the spec module independently defines the same formulas and re-exports those second definitions under the exec names. The reviewer questions the aliases and proposes binding the exec functions directly with `when_used_as_spec(frame_to_meta_spec)`; the author agrees. This matches `pair-exec-helpers-with-spec-models`, which requires one faithful model attached to each exec helper rather than duplicate formulas and aliases. The final head co-locates each model with its exec helper, attaches it directly, and re-exports the actual exec/spec pairs.
